svg.text: Who APEX is for — and where we start
APEX fits organisations whose value is expert know-how held in playbooks, decks and blueprints. We start with
engineering services, solution integrators and B2B pre-sales teams, then widen to Dropbox-standardised and

that keep data on their own
Primary: enough know-how to organise, fast decisions, one install.
Secondary: a division pilot that can expand.
Secondary: lighter package, fast onboarding of new hires.
Channel: resell, implement and convert content.
Note: Segments and size bands are hypotheses to validate in the first 10 discovery conversations.

svg.text: Focus the first sales effort on mid-sized engineering, integration and pre-sales organisations already
on Dropbox. Validate these segments in ten discovery conversations before widening the target.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
